lines: A grimy street corner in some rundown town.
In that corner, where public safety was the last thing on anyone's mind, shouts of rage echoed.
Thug 1
Where did they go? Search!
Thug 2
Once you find them, chase them to the ends of the earth and kill them!
Amidst the cries of these rough-looking men, two figures were running.
Kinu
Ugh, this is really ruining our vacation...
The one sighing was Izumo Kinu, on a trip with her husband, Library.
Just moments ago, she had been enjoying a studio where you could experience a popular drama series.
She had worn the costumes of the characters from the show, but it seemed that had caused some local thugs to mistake her for someone else.
Kinu
! Library-sama, there are many people ahead.
The enemy detection network she had been running while moving caught the presence and killing intent of multiple individuals.
Library
I called for reinforcements... but if we keep going like this, we'll drag in the general public.
Kinu
Yes, they really have no sense of proportion... Well, there is no one in this alleyway.
Library
To prevent any casualties, you mean to lure the enemies in and take them all down at once.
Kinu
Yes. Come, this way!
The two of them dove into the alley, and the thugs immediately swarmed in behind them.
Kinu
It seems everyone who was waiting in ambush has followed us... We'll finish this here!
She drew the two handguns that had been handed to her along with the costume and fired without hesitation.
Thug 1
Gyaah!
Thug 2
Gwaaah!!
Where the gunsmoke rose, the thugs let out screams of pain.
Library
Wha...!? Those are real guns!
Kinu
Yes, the weight was different when they were handed to me, so I thought it was a rather realistic cosplay prop.
Library
No, but... just knowing they were real guns means...
Kinu
Yes, I tried to aim away from the vital areas, and it seems I hit my mark, so I am relieved.
Kinu said it with a straight face, her expression smiling pleasantly.
But beneath that smile, a flame of anger was burning.
Kinu
That said, since I interrupted your precious time with the Library, I suppose I should make them pay for it.
Without breaking her smile, she pulled the trigger. Wherever the bullets flew, the thugs fell.
Kinu
Even a shot to the shoulder or leg hurts, doesn't it? That pain is my anger!
The muzzle kicked up repeatedly, and each time, a bullet was fired.
And the dynamic vision honed as a Taimanin of the Library caught the secret of those bullets.
Library
Are you possessing the bullets with spirits to adjust their trajectory?
Kinu
Yes, with these girls, this is easy.
As she spoke, more bullets flew out. The spirits clung to them, guiding the trajectories to suck into the enemies' guns or limbs.
Furthermore, the enemy bullets heading this way were swatted away by the spirits diving at them.
For whatever they missed, Kinu herself shot them down, deflecting them with her gun.
Her movements were so polished that the Library, while dodging bullets himself, began to harbor doubts.
Library
You're quite familiar with firearms... but your weapon is a sword. When did you learn to handle a gun?
Kinu
Basically, it's a machine. Once you try it, it's surprisingly straightforward and easy to understand. The bullet flies where you point it.
Kinu said this casually, pulling the trigger again and again.
Each time, a metallic clang and a scream rang out, and Kinu's smile deepened.
Kinu
The feedback is different from a sword, but the shock of the recoil becomes pleasant once you get used to it.
With a slightly flushed face, Kinu surrendered to the feel of the recoil.
Kinu
Though, compared to the impact of being pierced by the Library, it's not even comparable.
Library
W-What are you saying!?
As she looked at him and spoke with such implication, the Library, in the midst of battle, widened his eyes in shock.
Seeing the Library like that, Kinu wore a smile of genuine joy and spread her hands out sharply.
Sensing her intent, the spirits moved. The magazine dropped out quickly, and the reload was complete.
Kinu
Library, I've lured all the enemies ahead into the alley. The path is clear!
As she made the declaration, Kinu sprinted up the wall of the alley.
Thug 3
Nngh, gwaah!
Thug 4
Wh-what the hell? Where are you shooting from? Gah! Gyaah!
Struck by the hail of bullets raining down from above, the thugs were beaten down helplessly in their confusion.
But at that very moment, someone who had been moving separately burst in from the other side of the alley.
Library
Kinu! Enemies behind us!
The enemy had slipped through the Kogitsune's detection net, but the Library keenly sensed their presence and shot down the bullets flying at Kinu.
Kinu
Thank you, my Lord.
Library
Are you hurt?
Kinu
No, but... I cannot stand by and let you be put in any more danger, my Lord!
As she declared this, Kinu spread her arms wide, holding her gun out in front of her.
Kinu
My Lord, please take cover!
In stark contrast to her gentle voice, a rapid succession of gunshots erupted.
In the narrow alley, a massive volume of bullets was sprayed front and back, all of them raining down mercilessly on the enemies.
Thugs
Gwaah!
The overlapping screams rang out loud enough to drown out the gunfire.
Yet even amidst such noise, Kinu's stern voice carried clearly.
Kinu
I will shoot as many rounds as it takes into anyone who stands up to face us!
Under the merciless assault and the declaration of terror, the thugs collapsed one after another.
Leaping over the bodies of the men rolling on the ground, Kinu and the Library ran toward the end of the alley.
Library
Kinu! The enemies behind us have stopped advancing!
Kinu
Understood. I will push forward. My Lord, please cover our rear?
Library
Leave it to me!
In perfect sync, the two of them sprinted to exit the alley.
The thugs who had attacked from behind gave chase, but they moved sluggishly, cowed by Kinu's earlier gunfire.
Even so, the sporadic bullets fired at them were all shot down by the Library.
Kinu
As amazing as ever, my Lord! Come on, the exit is just ahead!
Running with a smile on her face, Kinu fired a bullet into the last enemy ahead of her.
There were no enemies left in sight, and with Kinu and the Library's speed, they could easily shake off the remaining foes once they cleared the alley.
But at that moment, an enemy who should have been knocked down swung his arm down with force while still lying on the ground.
Library
A grenade...!? Kinu!!
The Library, who had quickly identified the object flying toward them at the edge of her vision, let out a sharp cry.
Kinu
Thank you! This is nothing...!
The bullet Kinu fired in a swift reaction grazed the bottom of the grenade, knocking it high into the air.
Right where it rose, like a toss, the airborne Kotobuki performed a graceful somersault and delivered an overhead kick.
Kinu
My Lord! Jump!
Library
Oh!!
With the grenade blasting behind them, the two leaped high and burst out onto the main street.
Immediately after, a massive explosion erupted behind them.
The buildings couldn't withstand the blast in the narrow alley and began collapsing one after another.
The thugs were caught in the debris, blocking the alley, and no more pursuers appeared.
Kinu
Phew... we're safe for now. My Lord, are you hurt?
Library
Ah, yes... And you, Kinu. You were quite far ahead. Are you injured?
As Kinu asked with a bright smile, the Library nodded, looking slightly confused.
Library
Besides, your fighting style was unusually aggressive. It's not like the Kinu I usually know...
Kinu
You were trying to ruin our trip, My Lord? I was angry.
Library
I, I see...
At Kinu's childish gesture of puffing out her cheeks, the Library found herself unable to say anything more.
Kinu
If anything, I think your usual self is the more aggressive one.
Leaving the silent Library behind, Kinu muttered something else cryptic.
However, the fact that she had been looking forward to spending time with him was clearly conveyed to the Library.
Despite her age and strong sense of embarrassment, the Library looked into Kinu's eyes, responding to her feelings.
Kinu
My Lord...
Library
Kinu...
Their hands slowly intertwined, and their faces drew closer—
Thugs
Damn it! It's a total mess! They can't be far! Find them and kill them all!!
The angry shouts of a new group of thugs echoed from the distance.
The two of them hastily leaped back.
Library
We didn't manage to wipe them all out, did we...
Kinu
Ugh! We were just getting along so well, and now this...!
Library
Huh? Is that what you're upset about?
Seeing my wife puffing up with anger, the Library pulled back slightly.
But then, Kinu reached out to the Library again.
Kinu
C-come on, My Lord, give me your hand. I'll protect you properly.
The Library gripped her graceful yet strong hand in return.
Library
On my end, I can't just stand there as a husband while a gun is pointed at my wife.
Kinu
My Lord...
She was pulled in close, and Kinu's face broke into the biggest smile of the day.
Library
Alright, let's go, Kinu!
Kinu
Yes, My Lord!
The two Taimanin, hands clasped, ran off into the distance where the shouts were echoing.
